description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.resourceManager class, which manages resources such as plugins and themes within the CKEditor framework. It includes methods for registering, retrieving, and loading resources, as well as handling external resource paths.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.resourceManager
classes.description: A class for managing resources such as plugins and themes, providing methods to add, retrieve, and load resources, as well as manage external resource paths.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a resource with a given name and definition, and fires an event indicating the resource is ready.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a registered resource by name.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the URL path for a specific loaded resource.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full URL to the resource file for a specific resource.

methods.name: addExternal
methods.description: Registers external resource paths and files for specified resource names.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads one or more resources asynchronously and executes a callback upon completion.
